label: late original-phase steps (t=4-7) and <DEL> in sequences starting with s
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at t>=4 (peaking t=5) and at the <DEL> step; never at t<=2 or in the copy phase. It is strongly gated by the first original token: first_tok=s has 17x lift and holds 69% of activation mass, and every top-activating sequence starts with s (weaker: w, j, n). Higher activation quartiles are increasingly s-initial (75% of top quartile vs 40% of bottom). The input token itself matters little (mild preference for first occurrences). Precision is low, though: most late-phase steps in s-initial sequences stay inactive, and adding conditions on the second token, repeats of s, or to_go did not help. About 30% of mass comes from sequences that do not start with s.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=s (+5.95), orig0=w (+2.91), orig1=r (+2.65), orig0=j (+2.52), orig1=i (+2.18), orig0=n (+2.10). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.08), phase=2 (-7.69), t=3 (-4.72), prev_tok=h (-4.30).
